summary: Iter129 verification of production recovery + shooter/OWR launch. 6 targeted backend tests written and PASSING (catalog live shooter+owr, explicit runtime honored, provider_estimate hidden from support admin, cost fields stripped from GET /api/games/{id}, private_preview creator branch + 404 for other member, public_preview signed-in member progress+fire keys collect). Frontend e2e: signed-in member loaded /games hub, opened Neon Breach — iframe rendered title screen, tap started gameplay with canvas + 'Wave 1/2 · Enemies left' + 'Stage 1/3 · Score' HUD, NO game-runtime-error panel and NO SyntaxError in console. Emberwild demo playable as founder — title + canvas + 'Quests: 0/2 · Relics 0 · Roamers down 0' HUD. GameMakerSaved chips show friendly labels ('Published — Live', 'Archived'). Overall PASS.

integration_issues.issue: GET /api/games/demo-owr-emberwild-v1 returns 403 platform_restricted for member auditcheckreal (Neon Breach shooter is accessible to same member). Emberwild also NOT visible in /games hub listing for the member. Founder can play. Likely the OWR demo game is missing a per-game access config and falls through the legacy platform gate. Consider setting explicit access={mode:'published'} on demo-owr-emberwild-v1 to match Neon Breach.

action_items: (Minor) Investigate why demo-owr-emberwild-v1 is not visible/playable for normal signed-in members (auditcheckreal) — likely missing per-game access config causing platform gate to reject. Shooter demo works fine for the same member.
(Optional) Also ensure Emberwild appears in /games hub for members after fixing access.

rca of the issue: Emberwild 403 for member: routers/games.py falls into legacy platform_restricted gate when game document lacks a dict access field. Shooter demo works because it has access.mode=published. Fix: set access.mode='published' on demo-owr-emberwild-v1 via admin PUT or db update.
